title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Interpretive Note: Overpayments against a Parent Claim and the Extended Benefits Entitlement Measure
content:
For an Extended Benefits (EB) entitlement on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the parent entitlement measure reads the Benefit Overpayment Accounts held against the parent claim: their classification, their status and their principal amounts. The regular benefits paid on the parent claim are every payment issued on it less every cancelled payment.

## The measure

| Benefit Overpayment Accounts against the parent claim | Parent entitlement measure |
|---|---|
| Any fraud overpayment, of either fraud classification (Fraud Overpayment — First Offense or Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense) | Zero |
| No fraud overpayment, and one or more non-fraud overpayments at status established | The regular benefits paid less the sum of those overpayments' principal amounts |
| No fraud overpayment and no non-fraud overpayment at status established | The regular benefits paid |

## Points of interpretation

- A fraud overpayment counts whatever its status.
- A non-fraud overpayment counts only while its status is established; one in recovery, paid in full, waived or in any other status is not deducted.
- Non-fraud classifications are Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error, Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error, Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal and Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error.

### Hypothetical cases (regular benefits paid on the parent of 9000.00)

| Overpayments against the parent | Measure |
|---|---|
| One Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error, established, principal 1200.00 | 7800.00 |
| The same, plus a Fraud Overpayment — First Offense, paid in full | 0.00 |
| One Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error, paid in full | 9000.00 |
